text_device_management: Review the devices that you have logged in Shopee account.
text_popup_security_reminder: If you don't recognize this device, change your password immediately to secure your account.
text_popup_confirm_remove_device: Are you sure you want to REMOVE {devicename} ? This will LOG OUT the device from your Shopee account. You will be required to verify your identify if you want to login the device again.
text_device_management_faq_answer_1: The device management list shows the devices that your Shopee account is currently logged into. Upon removal, you will be logged out from the device. Identity verification is required to log in to the device again.
text_device_management_faq_answer_2:
For account security purposes, it is strongly recommended to remove a device if:
1. it is NOT owned by you
2. it is lost or no longer in use
text_device_management_faq_answer_3: Unfortunately, possibility is that your logged in device cannot be recognized by system. You may judge whether to remove the device based on last activity time, location and other information.
text_device_management_faq_answer_4:
Since device display has dependency on data synchronization, your device may not be displayed under certain circumstances (including but not limited to):
1. No recent activity
2. Logged in on non-Shopee platforms
text_device_management_faq_answer_5: Please check whether you have authorized your Shopee account to log in to other platforms. If the device info matches your common device, you do not need to remove it. We will continue to optimize the device display list. Sorry for any inconvenience caused.
text_device_management_faq_answer_6:
The removal may fail for the following reasons:
1. There is no network signal or the signal is poor. Please connect to the Internet and try again.
2. System timeout or other system issues, please try again later.
text_error_popup_fail_remove_device: Something went wrong. Please try again later. Click the button below for more info.
